dedupe_keys.name: european audiovisual observatory yearbook online service audiovisual market statistics

description: The Yearbook Online Service of the European Audiovisual Observatory is an online collection of statistical tables on television, video on demand, cinema and home video in 42 European states, produced each year from national regulators, statistical offices, industry bodies and commercial sources. For broadcasting it gives revenues of public and private television and radio broadcasters, including licence fees, public funding and advertising, audience shares of the main channels and groups, the number of channels and services, and figures on distribution by terrestrial, cable, satellite and IPTV platforms, alongside the leading companies. The Observatory uses these data in its free reports, such as the estimate that Europe's audiovisual market is worth about 142 billion euros, and in key trends publications. The 2025 edition was released as an updated online service. Coverage: 42 European states, multi-year time series. Format and access: online tables and Excel downloads under a paid subscription; summaries and some reports free. Caveats: mixes official and commercial sources with different definitions; radio is covered less than television. Simulation uses: economic context for broadcasting in scenario studies, revenue exposure of broadcasters to disruptions, and platform mix for resilience of broadcast distribution. Related records: MAVISE is the Observatory's free service register, and the OECD broadband databases cover telecom markets.
